fact: 1908年夏季奥运会在伦敦举行，1908年4月27日由爱德华七世国王宣布正式开幕；这是首次专门为奥运会兴建体育场的一届，共有22个代表团、2008名运动员（含37名女性）参加110个项目的比赛。

sources.quote: The 1908 Summer Olympics were an international multi-sport event held in London, United Kingdom, from 27 April to 31 October 1908.

fact: 1908年7月24日的伦敦奥运会马拉松从温莎城堡起跑、终点为伦敦体育场；组委会将赛程定为42公里195米（26英里385码），该距离自1924年起成为正式马拉松标准距离。意大利选手Dorando Pietri虽率先进入体育场，但因接受工作人员帮助被取消成绩，美国选手Johnny Hayes被宣布为冠军。

fact: Kenneth Grahame的《柳林风声》（The Wind in the Willows）1908年6月由伦敦Methuen出版首版，上市当月即需要第二版；虽初评褒贬不一但迅速走红，后成为英语儿童文学经典，1929年被A.A.米尔恩改编为戏剧《Toad of Toad Hall》。

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica - The Wind in the Willows
sources.quote: The Wind in the Willows, book of linked animal tales by British writer Kenneth Grahame that began as a series of bedtime stories for his son and was published in 1908. ... Although initially met with mixed reviews, the book quickly became popular. Its fans included U.S. Pres. Theodore Roosevelt and English writer A.A. Milne, the latter of whom extracted Toad's adventures for the play Toad of Toad Hall (1929)

fact: 根据妇女工业理事会《伦敦的家庭工业》（Home Industries of Women in London）1897年与1908年两轮调查，伦敦女性家庭计件工人的周薪因行业差异较大，平均约7至9先令，每周工作约40至45小时。

sources.title: Jessica S. Bean, Women's Work and the Household Economy: Poverty, Policy and Female Labor Supply in Britain, 1897-1931（康奈尔大学博士论文, 2012）
sources.quote: Weekly wages and hours of work varied considerably by industry, but averaged about 7-9s. and 40-45 hours per week, with many workers reporting the desire for more work.

fact: 英国1908年《养老金法》（Old Age Pensions Act 1908）设立非缴费养老金：70岁以上、年收入低于31英镑10先令且品行良好者可领取，单身每周5先令、夫妇每周7先令5便士，由郡议会设立的地方养老金委员会管理，自1909年1月1日起发放，首批约596,038人受益。

sources.title: Mark Pack - On this day in 1909, the first state pensions came in
sources.quote: Introduced by the Old-Age Pensions Act 1908, the non-contributory state pensions were for the over 70s and administered via local pension committees set up by county councils ... The first wave of pensions numbered 596,038, who were entitled to 5 shillings a week (single people) or 7 shillings 5 pence a week (couples).

sources.title: National Archives of Ireland - Census search forms 1841 and 1851（养老金年龄证明背景）
sources.quote: The Old Age Pensions Act of 1908 was an Act of Parliament of the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland. This introduced a non-contributory pension for people aged 70 and over in England, Wales, Scotland, and Ireland. Pensions began in January 1909. To qualify, applicants needed to meet the following criteria: Be at least 70 years old, Have an annual income below £31 10s, Be of good character

fact: 《1908年儿童法》（Children Act 1908, 8 Edw. 7 c. 67）于1908年12月21日获御准，整合并改革儿童与少年保护法律：设立少年法庭（第110条），废除对儿童与少年的死刑（第103条），并禁止向儿童与少年出售烟草（第三部分）。

[21st December 1908.] ... PART III. JUVENILE SMOKING. 39. Penalty on selling tobacco to children and young persons ... 103. Abolition of death sentence in case of children and young persons ... 110. sources.title: The British Academy - Reframing Childhood Past and Present: Chronologies
sources.quote: 1908 Children Act Established juvenile courts. The Act gave local authorities powers to keep children out of workhouses or prisons, prevented children working in dangerous trades, and prevented them from entering pubs or purchasing cigarettes.

fact: 《1907年有限合伙法》（Limited Partnerships Act 1907）自1908年1月1日起生效，使英格兰与苏格兰法律首次允许设立有限合伙：部分合伙人可以其出资额为限承担有限责任。

sources.title: 爱尔兰企业贸易就业部（Department of Enterprise, Tourism and Employment）- Review of Limited Partnerships Act 1907
sources.quote: The Limited Partnerships Act 1907 came into effect on 1 January 1908. Its purpose is to allow for partnerships where some members may have limited liability.

sources.title: Isle of Man Company Law Reform Advisory Committee论文（OIT Vol. 6-3-4, Patrick Taylor）
sources.quote: Such partnerships were, however, unknown to the laws of England and Scotland prior to 1st January 1908, on which date the Limited Partnerships Act 1907 came into force.

fact: 1908年，伦敦各相互独立的地下铁路公司同意统一使用Underground一词进行联合服务推广；同年District Railway（UERL旗下公司）开始使用大小写突出的Underground字样和蓝色横条加红色圆盘的站牌设计，成为后来伦敦地铁圆形标志（roundel）的前身。

sources.title: London Transport Museum - The evolution of the roundel
sources.quote: In 1908, the various separate underground railway companies agreed to use the term 'Underground' for all their joint promotion of services.

sources.title: Tramway Badges and Buttons - London United Tramways（公司史与标志考证）
sources.quote: The distinctive lettering (larger first and final letters) was a design promoted by the District Railway (a UERL company) in 1908 as a means of branding London's underground railways (not just the District Railway). At the same time, the District Railway also began to introduce station signage that is clearly recognisable as the forerunner of the later 'bullseye' logo.
